protocol: Select one previously unused Freesound original recording per ESC-50 target by SHA256 order, preferring fold 5. No source name, candidate list, context or filename supplied to either captioner. Both describe the complete unchanged mono recording. Frozen MiniLM cosine maps each free description to one of the same 50 English category names (underscores replaced by spaces). Report top-1, per-recording paired bootstrap, and independently score CLAP directly matching all labels as a prompted catalogue comparison. Only frozen resources, no threshold or prompt search on this set. This tests environmental source identification on short isolated recordings, not human hearing. Overlap with model pretraining is unknown.

rows.label: dog
rows.control: a dog is barking loudly at a steady pace
rows.checked: a dog is barking and growling
rows.moss: A small dog barks rapidly and persistently in a quiet indoor space, with no other sounds present.

rows.label: rooster
rows.control: a chicken is clucking while birds are chirping in the background
rows.checked: a chicken is clucking while birds chirp in the background
rows.moss: A rooster crows loudly in a quiet, open outdoor space, with no other sounds present.

rows.label: pig
rows.control: a large animal is making a very loud buzzing sound
rows.checked: a large animal is making a very loud noise
rows.moss: A loud, high-pitched, and sustained horse neigh is heard, indicating a single animal in an open outdoor environment with no background noise.

rows.label: cow
rows.control: several cows are mooing and birds are chirping in the background
rows.checked: several cows are mooing and birds are chirping in the background
